full_prompt_en: A restrained photographic collage places an elderly seated woman within a compact arrangement of geometric shapes on a flat beige-gray background. She is seen in left-facing profile, slightly left of centre, with silver-gray hair gathered into a low bun and small round spectacles catching pale light. Her chin lifts gently and her gaze extends toward the left edge. A loose olive-gray buttoned garment falls over her shoulders and bends into soft folds at her elbows and lap. Her hands rest low beside a cluster of fine dried stems and brown flower heads that spreads across the lower-left part of the figure. The seated body is cropped near the lower thighs by a rectangular edge, giving the photographic portion a deliberate cutout appearance. Behind her, overlapping sage-green and gray rectangles rise vertically at uneven heights. A large dark green circle sits behind the left side of her head and shoulder. On the right, a broad ochre-orange circle contrasts with the cooler blocks, while smaller ochre and orange circular segments appear near the lower left and right. A dark circular fragment is partly visible behind the lower-right edge of the figure. The geometric shapes have clean boundaries and areas of apparent transparency, distinct from the fine photographic texture of hair, fabric, and dried foliage. Soft directional light catches the top of her hair, the glasses, and selected folds, while her face and torso retain quiet shadow. Generous blank space surrounds the central collage. Muted olive, sage, beige, and ochre produce a calm balance between the human profile and abstract geometry.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅克制的摄影拼贴，一位端坐的老年女性置于紧凑的几何形状组合中，背景为平坦灰米色。人物略偏中央左侧，以朝左的侧脸示人，银灰头发盘成低发髻，小圆眼镜接住浅色光。下巴轻轻抬起，视线朝向左边缘。宽松橄榄灰色纽扣衣服从肩上垂下，在肘部与膝上形成柔软褶皱。双手低放在腿前，旁边一簇纤细干茎与褐色干花横展于人物左下方。坐姿躯干在大腿下部附近被矩形边缘裁切，使摄影部分呈现明确剪贴感。她身后，鼠尾草绿与灰色矩形高低不齐地竖向叠起；大深绿圆形位于头肩左后方，右侧宽阔赭橙圆形与冷色块相对，下方两侧还有更小的赭黄、橙色圆形片段。人物右下缘后方露出一部分深色圆形。几何形状边界干净，部分叠压处带通透感，与头发、布料、干枝的细腻摄影纹理相区分。柔和方向光照到头发顶部、眼镜和部分衣褶，面部与躯干仍保留安静阴影。中央拼贴四周留有大片空白，低调橄榄绿、鼠尾草绿、米色和赭色使人物侧影与抽象几何取得平和均衡。
style_prompt_en: A layered collage treatment juxtaposes softly modeled photographic texture with clean geometric areas and open matte space. The style places softly modeled forms against broad, simple geometric fields. Muted gray-green and charcoal tones are balanced by a single warm ochre accent, while pale neutrals keep the contrast gentle. Circles and rectangles overlap without heavy outlines, creating structure through scale and placement. Fine tonal transitions model textured areas, while flat shapes retain clear boundaries and translucent overlaps. Fine details are sparse and delicate against larger quiet shapes. The composition balances a narrow vertical mass with broader rounded and squared forms, producing a contemplative, orderly effect. Its visual character comes from restrained color, softened contours and the contrast between organic curves and simple geometry.
style_prompt_zh: 层叠拼贴表现将柔和塑形的摄影纹理与干净几何区域、开阔哑光空间并置。这种风格将柔和塑形的形体置于宽阔简洁的几何色域之前。低饱和灰绿与炭灰由一处暖赭色点缀平衡，浅中性色则让整体反差温和。圆形和矩形彼此叠压，却没有厚重描边，主要依靠大小和位置建立结构。细腻明暗过渡塑造有纹理的区域，平面形状则保留清晰边界和半透明叠压。精细细节稀少，与大块宁静色域形成对照。构图以狭窄竖向形体平衡宽阔圆形和方形，产生沉思而有序的效果。视觉特征来自克制色彩、柔和轮廓，以及有机曲线与简洁几何之间的对照。
theme_en: An elderly woman with a gray bun and round glasses sits among muted geometric shapes
theme_zh: 灰发髻、圆眼镜的老年女性坐在低饱和几何形状之间
name: Muted colors
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
